entries.ro: Faină poveste – uh, trebuie să plec.

entries.en: Uh… That's no news… They-they killed him, how's that news?
entries.ro: Ăă… Nu-i nicio noutate… L-au ucis, ce noutate e asta?

entries.en: Uh-huh… Got pics…? Braindance? Nice, then we can talk.
entries.ro: Aham… Ai poze…? Braindance? Ok, atunci vorbim.

entries.en: Let's get the fuck outta here!
entries.ro: Hai să ne cărăm dracu' de-aici!

entries.en: Don't – don't do this to me, please!
entries.ro: Nu – nu-mi face asta, te rog!

entries.en: Oh great… you some kind of pervert?
Listen, I-I got nothing valuable, OK?
entries.ro: Ascultă, n-nu am nimic de valoare, OK?

entries.en: He was trying to run the fuck away, what did he expect? Flowers…? Exactly… Uhh.
entries.ro: Încerca să fugă ca dracu', ce se aștepta? Flori…? Exact… Ăă.

entries.en: How much do you want for it…? Uh-huh... Ok, I want it today… Great.
entries.ro: Cât vrei pe el…? Aham... Ok, îl vreau azi… Bine.
